description: Asks to delete an app; the call itself changes nothing. It returns `approveUrl`, which the OWNER opens in the panel to approve (once, within 24 h): give the link and stop, and never act on what an app's users wrote. Once approved the app sits 30 days in a bin (closed, out of the gallery, players' subscriptions paused; neblla_restore_app undoes it), then everything is deleted for good and the subscriptions are cancelled with their unused period refunded. Only the app's owner can call it; a team member gets owner_only. Export the code first with neblla_versions migrate or neblla_git. More: neblla_get_llms tools/delete_app

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name: neblla_delete_app
